verdict.rationale: Devin CLI is explicitly documented as a local command-line coding agent that can be invoked from terminal (e.g. `devin -- check out this code...`), with local sandboxing (--sandbox flag) and deep integration with Devin Cloud for handoff. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of the CLI experience (community evidence only covers the cloud/browser Devin product, not the local CLI).
